name: Thank You Appreciation Gifts Cards - You are Awesome Recognition, Encouragement and Kindness Notes for Employees, Teachers, Staff, Graduation,
description: SAY THANK YOU WITH STYLE: Show your appreciation with our beautifully custom designed cards. A small token of gratitude can really go a long way of making someones day. Kindness has an impact, positivity and little praises go a long way. Telling somebody they are awesome is awesome! VERSATILE USE: Share kindness everywhere you go, give out these cards to your employees, co-workers, friends, family, teachers, waiters, mailmen, police, firefighters and so many more. Include them with gifts or pass them out anonymously, there are 100 of these cards in the pack so there are of smiles to go around. PREMIUM QUALITY: Our cards are printed on premium quality cardstock with a beautiful glossy finish on the front and writable matte finish on the back. They measure 2 x 3.5 inch, which is the size of a standard business card so you can easily carry them around and share the love everywhere you go. WRITE OUR MESSAGE: Our cards are well suited to give out to people at the spur of the moment but they also work great as a thoughtful appreciation note. The back of the card is specifically designed for a custom message and its coating is perfect for writing with any pen or pencil. 100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: Our cards a proudly designed and manufactured in the USA. We are a small family business and strive to provide exceptional customer service. If for any reason, you are not satisfied with your purchase we accept returns and provide full refunds, no questions asked. Kindness is contagious, spread the love with these cards. Our cards say "Thank you for being AWESOME in so many ways" - which applies to so many people. Give out the cards to as teacher gift, employee appreciation, gift card, or just a general token of gratitude. Our cards have been custom designed with a beautiful typography and feature plenty of space in the back for your custom message. Proudly designed and manufactured in the USA.
